name: Uruk-hai Rampage
game_text:
To play, spot an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area.
<phase>Response</phase>: If your Uruk-hai wins a skirmish, remove <twilight>3</twilight> to make him <keyword>fierce</keyword> until the regroup phase.
flavor_text: Victory breeds rage in Saruman’s foul creations.
